defense_news.title: Pentagon tells Europeans to cool their rhetoric on Russia, sources say
defense_news.summary: Pentagon officials have in recent weeks asked several NATO countries to tone down their rhetoric regarding the threat posed by Russia, sources told Reuters.

defense_news.title: Hasty US exit from Europe could drive allies away from American arms, RAND says
defense_news.summary: A rapid, uncoordinated U.S. military drawdown from Europe could push key NATO allies further away from American weapons, a RAND study found.
